module_name: M1 — Astra One and full SDA qualification

parents.milestone: M1 — Astra One and full SDA qualification
parents.title: Audit and import Astra One Linux v0.2.0 package into isolated source staging
parents.acceptance: Package manifest/tests verified; actual source committed for review, not treated as production
module_guardrails: One deterministic Master and five isolated Codex worktrees; never run two Masters on one queue.
Workers cannot self-approve, merge to develop, change protected policies or deploy.
Independent QC and serialized Merger are mandatory.

subtasks.title: Pin source and destination SHAs
subtasks.instruction: Pin exact source repository/ref/commit and destination base SHA for Audit and import Astra One Linux v0.2.0 package into isolated source staging; verify destination is isolated and legacy source untouched.
subtasks.deliverable: Source/target identity record and SHA pair.
subtasks.done_when: Source and target are immutable for this attempt.

subtasks.title: Inventory provenance and compatibility
subtasks.instruction: Inventory files, dependencies, licenses, secrets, data formats, case collisions and compatibility; record per-file provenance.
subtasks.deliverable: File manifest and provenance ledger.
subtasks.done_when: Every candidate has origin SHA/path/license status and secret-scan disposition.

subtasks.title: Run read-only dry run
subtasks.instruction: Run read-only dry-run/staging simulation; detect collisions, incompatibilities, path traversal and unsafe files before applying.
subtasks.deliverable: Dry-run report and compatibility matrix.
subtasks.done_when: Dry-run makes no destination writes; unresolved collisions block application.

subtasks.title: Apply bounded migration
subtasks.instruction: Apply only approved create-only/adapter/migration slice for Audit and import Astra One Linux v0.2.0 package into isolated source staging; do not delete, execute or overwrite legacy source.
subtasks.deliverable: Bounded destination changes and migration receipt.
subtasks.done_when: Only allowlisted files are changed and provenance is recorded.

subtasks.title: Verify migrated result
subtasks.instruction: Run provenance, schema, behavior, regression and security checks on destination.
subtasks.deliverable: Verification report and file-hash comparison.
subtasks.done_when: All content is traceable and required behavior passes.

subtasks.title: Prove rollback and restore
subtasks.instruction: Exercise rollback/restore from checkpoint or disposable staging target; prove source and last-known-good destination remain recoverable.
subtasks.deliverable: Rollback drill record and verified restore SHA.
subtasks.done_when: Rollback is demonstrated without destructive cleanup or loss.

subtasks.title: Commit and hand off migration candidate
subtasks.instruction: Commit reviewed candidate on task branch and hand off to independent QC with provenance, test evidence, gaps and next gate.
subtasks.deliverable: Candidate commit and migration handoff receipt.
subtasks.done_when: No production cutover, main promotion or legacy retirement occurs here.

parents.completion_rule: Complete all child steps; satisfy owner gate if present; pass independent QC bound to candidate SHA; pass serialized merge. Only then mark parent completed.

subtasks.title: Inspect source and baseline
subtasks.instruction: Pin and inspect the repositories, refs, files, PRs, logs, databases or host evidence named by this task and its reuse notes. Record SHAs, timestamps and current state; do not modify inspected sources.
subtasks.deliverable: Evidence inventory with exact refs/SHAs, paths, current behavior and unknowns.
subtasks.done_when: Material claims trace to concrete sources and no inspected source was changed.

subtasks.title: Compare evidence to acceptance
subtasks.instruction: Compare inspected evidence with the parent objective and acceptance. Identify duplicates, conflicts, gaps, risks, platform constraints and relevant prior mistakes.
subtasks.deliverable: Findings matrix mapping every acceptance clause to evidence, gap or blocker.
subtasks.done_when: Every acceptance clause has a supported finding; assumptions are labelled.

subtasks.title: Record findings and decision
subtasks.instruction: Write a task-specific audit/decision record with findings, options, recommendation, rejected alternatives and evidence references.
subtasks.deliverable: Versioned report or decision record in approved docs path.
subtasks.done_when: Report is reproducible and distinguishes fact from inference.

subtasks.title: Independently cross-check evidence
subtasks.instruction: Independently re-check critical SHAs, paths, counts and conclusions; confirm no unrelated changes or sensitive data disclosure.
subtasks.deliverable: Review checklist and evidence receipt.
subtasks.done_when: Independent check agrees or unresolved differences keep parent blocked.

subtasks.title: Build acceptance matrix
subtasks.instruction: Convert parent acceptance into observable assertions and define fixtures/environment needed for Verify Codex supervisor, worker, QC and merger model profiles.
subtasks.deliverable: Acceptance matrix with expected/observed outcomes.
subtasks.done_when: Every acceptance clause is measurable.

subtasks.title: Prepare deterministic fixtures
subtasks.instruction: Prepare deterministic sanitized fixtures and record environment/model/device versions.
subtasks.deliverable: Fixture set and environment snapshot.
subtasks.done_when: Fixtures are repeatable, contain no secrets and cover normal/boundary cases.

subtasks.title: Execute required checks
subtasks.instruction: Execute required local tests, integration checks or host/device drills for Verify Codex supervisor, worker, QC and merger model profiles; capture commands, exit codes and artifact hashes.
subtasks.deliverable: Test evidence and result summary.
subtasks.done_when: All runnable checks complete; skipped checks are explicitly pending.

subtasks.title: Exercise negative and failure cases
subtasks.instruction: Exercise denial, corruption, duplicate, outage, restart, rollback or adversarial cases relevant to this parent.
subtasks.deliverable: Negative/fault-injection evidence.
subtasks.done_when: No safety boundary is bypassed; failures are reproducible.

subtasks.title: Write verification report
subtasks.instruction: Compare results with acceptance and produce pass/fail/blocked report with remaining risks.
subtasks.deliverable: Verification report bound to source SHA and artifact hashes.
subtasks.done_when: No mock-only or quota-blocked check is reported as passed.
